o.text: Inherited from Proto-Turkic *yōl. Cognate with Turkish yol, Chuvash ҫул (śul), etc.

From Proto-Turkic *tẹri (“skin”). Cognate with Turkmen deri, Turkish deri,
Kazakh терi (teri),
Karachay-Balkar тери (teri), Kumyk тери (teri), Kyrgyz тери (teri),
Uzbek teri,
Uyghur تېرە (tëre),
Yakut тирии (tirii), Dolgan тирии, Tatar тире (tire) and
Bashkir тире (teri).
Borrowed from Classical Persian گَاوآلُو (gāw'ālū, “a large variety of plum”), seemingly from گَاو (gāw, “cow”) + آلُو (ālū, “plum”).
